bio: As part of a Wild King's coronation, they must prove they have the will to Invoke Keltaur – the first Titan born of these untamed Eldrin, and representative of their passionate spirit. A would-be Wild King must ford the Bright River, hunt a dire-bear, and trek to the heart of the Puregrove, all before nightfall. Only then, can they be truly considered a ruler worthy of Invoking Keltaur.
